timeline.message:
[7.16] Correctly merge lists with primitives

When merging plain lists we shouldn't cast them to `List<Map<String, V>>. If we do that we get a `ClassCastException` in runtime,
e.g. if the list contains strings, not maps.

This issue has been already fixed in 8.0 during one of the refactorings, but it hasn't been fixed in 7.x.

Fixes #78211
timeline.author: Artem Prigoda
